final: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scan_count, SUM(sc.gbsize) / SUM(sc.spanmin) AS rate FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), rate_average AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT status, total_scan_count, rate, rate - avg_rate AS rate_above_average FROM status_rates CROSS JOIN rate_average WHERE rate > avg_rate
